notes.title: Autumn Sale -15%! Online Co-op Mode on the Way—Team Up with 4 Players!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Iron Core: Mech Survivor – First-Ever Autumn Sale, 15% Off at a New Lowest Price![/b][/h3][p][b]Survivors, this is your chance—don’t miss it![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/daab6063d4a396f4fc686b0007aec4d7de9759b9.png"][/img][/p][p][b]And here’s the big news: Online Co-op Mode is coming soon![/b][/p][p][b]Team up with friends, form a 4-player tactical squad, and fight back against the apocalypse together.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]In Co-op Mode, up to 4 survivors can pilot mechs, face relentless swarms, and unleash firepower side by side. Only teamwork will keep hope alive.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/bc4fbae9de88a2cb766055fb0ee84dd96d3641a9.gif"][/img][/p][p]This mode introduces brand-new stage-based progression: break through area by area, overcome challenges, and push toward victory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/bd1f62f0f830f4060a178f43dd1652dc8b10d4b4.gif"][/img][/p][p]More details will be revealed soon—follow us for the latest updates![/p][p][b]Online Co-op Mode is almost here. Get ready to rejoin the fight![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/7e4214d4fbca1f6e435ad5301e0c0a0fd11adaf3.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p]
[/p][p]This is just the beginning—more gameplay updates are planned, and your feedback matters. Stay tuned, and join our official Discord Channel.[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 15 – Performance Optimization, UX Improvement & Skill Bug Fixes
notes.content: [h3]Performance Optimization & Skill Bug Fixes[/h3][p][b]Optimization & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Optimized the explosion effects for fuel barrels.[/p][/*][*][p]Further optimized memory usage and reduced file size.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed invisible wall issues on the [i]Emberwild[/i] map.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could fail to launch under certain rare hardware configurations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Reactor Ultimate Skill “Precision Strike (Missiles)” could fail to lock on and deploy in certain cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI display issues for the Reactor Ultimate Skill cooldown and lock-on indicators.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved controller navigation on the skill unlock screen by adding a highlighted selection state for buttons.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash issue.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]Thank you, Survivors, for all your feedback and suggestions! We will continue to fix and optimize the known issues in future updates.[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 14 - New Auto-Fire Mode & Sound Optimization
notes.content: [h2]New Auto-Fire Mode & Sound Optimization[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]Improvements and Adjustments:[/h3][olist][*][p]Auto-Fire can now switch between [b][u]\[Full Auto][/u][/b] [b]auto-aim + shooting[/b] and [b][u]\[Semi-Auto][/u][/b] [b]auto-shooting modes[/b]. You can press B (or the down direction on the DPad for controllers) to enable auto-aim, and use N (or the right direction on the DPad for controllers) to switch modes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/6f54bc4cd69a094107e7860921bdb0b81f525dc2.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Smoke indicators added for collectible items during pick-up missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments for the normal difficulty of the first level.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization of certain sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance and memory usage optimization.[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][olist][*][p]Fixed the issue with shortened invincibility frames during elite monster and Boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor issues resolved. [/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to all the survivors for your feedback and suggestions. We will continue to fix and optimize known issues in future updates.[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 13 — New Friends Leaderboard, Crosshair Visibility Adjustment
notes.content: [h3]Friends Ranking Added to Leaderboards, Enhanced & Adjustable Crosshair Visibility[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Added a [b]Friends Leaderboard[/b] to the rankings system.[/p][/*][*][p]Further reduced [b]memory and VRAM usage[/b] — package size has dropped from the initial 4.4 GB to 3.3 GB.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]initial attack speed[/b] of the [b]Sentinel mech[/b] and improved the [b]drop rate of elemental cards[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual effects of [b]explosive supply drops[/b] to make them easier to distinguish.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized [b]third-person camera position and FOV[/b] to reduce motion sickness.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced [b]crosshair contrast and visibility[/b], and added a [b]color customization option[/b] in settings — supports high-contrast colors (e.g., green).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted [b]upgrade cards[/b] for card towers — significantly increased values for HP boost, attack speed boost, and tower armor boost cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the [b]movement speed of mobile turrets[/b] when following the player.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]language setting was sometimes lost[/b] when entering the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed untranslated text on the [b]results screen[/b].[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks to all Survivors for your feedback and suggestions! We will continue to fix and optimize known issues in future updates. If you have more feedback, feel free to join our Discord and share your suggestions in the [b]Feedback[/b] section.[/p]

notes.title: Iron Core Defense has Reached a Key Victory — Thank You for Your Support!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for your incredible support! As of today, our sales have almost reached [b]10,000 copies[/b]!
For a fully independent team of just [b]five developers[/b], this means the world to us.[/p][p]At the same time, we’ve received a huge amount of valuable feedback from you — most of it focused on:[/p][list][*][p][b]Performance issues[/b] in the game[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early-stage difficulty and balance[/b] problems[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI guidance and configurable settings[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]                    We sincerely apologize for all frustrating experiences[/b][/h3][h3][b]                      We promise we’re working hard to deliver the best[/b][/h3][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Based on your feedback and our designers’ research, we’ve been working around the clock — pushing [b]4 major updates[/b] in just [b]48 hours[/b], with [b]22 feature improvements[/b] and [b]9 bug fixes[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Significantly reduced memory usage and package size[/b], and major performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted early-stage levels and the first mech’s balance[/b], allowing players to unlock and enjoy later normal-difficulty content faster.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved mission prompts and operation tips[/b] to help new survivors get through the early game more easily.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Major upgrades to Tower Defense builds[/b] — faster deployment, shorter cooldowns, and healing towers now repair nearby defenses. We’ll continue refining Tower Defense and other build-based combat![/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]toggles for damage numbers and controller vibration[/b], and enhanced the [b]range indicators and projectile visuals[/b] so you can keep better track of combat even in late-game chaos.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to these updates, the gameplay experience is already much better than at launch — but we know we’re still far from perfect, and we’re not stopping here.[/p][p]Next, we’ll continue optimizing the game, including [b]better controller support[/b], [b]clearer map objectives[/b], and [b]improved tower deployment controls[/b]. We’ll also keep expanding the game’s content to bring you even more to explore![/p][p]Thank you again for standing with us![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/1a609f702986ed5dc408939d680500b816779c46.png"][/img][/p][p]If you have any thoughts or suggestions regarding future content updates, we warmly invite you to participate in our survey. Your feedback will help us deliver better game content for everyone. [/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1WFd5XpMktaIy3TfKlIa0IAWNy3KQ5slLOUtkLLl-WdY/viewform?edit_requested=true" style="button"]Share Your Feedback[/url][/p][p]Once again, thank you for your support and trust. We sincerely hope to work together with all of you to make the game even better![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Recent Patches Note[/h3][hr][/hr][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]Adjusted unlock conditions for 2nd & 3rd mechs.,[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized enemy stats in the first map.,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced package size from 4.4 GB to 4.0 GB.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added toggle & size option for damage numbers (Settings → Gameplay).,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced monster damage by 15%.,[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered difficulty of last three maps by 15%.,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved crosshair contrast, added hit animations & monster death sounds.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added explosion airdrop range indicator.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to disable controller vibration.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added card selection key prompt.,[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced mission/mining guidance UI animations.,[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized VRAM/memory for stability.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added operation guide list (sprint always shown, larger text).,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved minimap size & marker colors.,[/p][/*][*][p]Healing Tower repairs nearby turrets.,[/p][/*][*][p]Increased tower defense deployment time; greatly reduced cooldowns.,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Flame Tower initial cost.,[/p][/*][*][p]Buff towers now always show range.,[/p][/*][*][p]Standardized tower armor.,[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed tower upgrade cards (HP, attack speed, armor).,[/p][/*][*][p]Shorter Auto-Build Tower card interval.,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Missile Tower hit VFX & explosion drop indicators.,[/p][/*][/olist][p] [b]Bug Fixes[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]Random Supply Crate bombs no longer harm players; increased their range & damage to enemies.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added DX11 compatible mode to fix black screen on launch.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI misalignment with non-standard resolutions.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed repeated language selection issues.,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed auto-language detection to prevent crashes.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed map selection highlight issue.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flickering floating numbers.,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved localization.,[/p][/*][*][p]Other bug fixes & performance improvements.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]For more information, please refer to: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3586420"]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3586420[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] August 11 – Enhanced Game Tutorial, UI & Performance Optimization
notes.content: [p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after selecting a language but not entering the game, returning to the main menu would require selecting the language again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the selected map was not highlighted when entering it from the map selection screen.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Improved crosshair visibility by enhancing contrast.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hit animations for the crosshair and death sound effects for monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an explosion airdrop range indicator.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a setting to disable controller vibration.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a key prompt for card selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced UI animation strength for mission guidance to improve clarity for missions and mining instructions.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized VRAM and memory usage for better stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an operation guide list in the bottom-left corner: sprint command is now always displayed, and guide size has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted minimap size and marker colors to improve recognition.[/p][/*][/olist][p]We appreciate all feedback and suggestions from our survivors. We will continue to fix and optimize known issues in future updates.[/p]

notes.title: [UPDATE] Adjustable Damage Numbers, Balance Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.content: [p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where setting a non-standard aspect ratio resolution in the settings would cause misalignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, if the player did not enter the game on the first attempt and returned to the UI, it would require re-selecting the language.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash issue caused by the auto-language initialization function. This detection has been removed, and language selection is now fully handled by the player.[/p][/*][/olist][p][b]Optimizations & Adjustments[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Further performance optimization: reduced package size from 4.4 GB to 4.0 GB.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to toggle damage number display, along with adjustable number size (Settings → Gameplay).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted monster damage (damage reduced by 15%).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted difficulty of the last three maps (overall difficulty reduced by 15%).[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you to all Survivors for your feedback and suggestions! We will continue fixing and optimizing the known issues in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Got more feedback? Join our Discord channel![/p]

notes.title: Iron Core: Mech Survivor – A Dual-Perspective Tower Defence & Roguelike Shooter!
notes.content:
[p]Your mech squad is on standby — awaiting your command to strike at any moment![/p][p]Thank you, Survivors, for your patience. Without your support, there would be no light in this post-apocalyptic world.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎉 [b]Launch Discount & Bundles – Save up to 25%![/b][/p][p]The game launches with a [b]limited-time 10% launch discount[/b]![/p][p]We’ve also teamed up with [i]Chicken Mechanic Oasis[/i] and [i]Twisted Fairy Tales: Dream Survivors[/i] to bring you [b]two special value bundles[/b].[/p][p][b]Stack your discounts[/b] with these bundles and enjoy up to [b]25% off[/b] in total! Don’t miss out, Survivors![/p][hr][/hr][p]🚀 [b]Key Features[/b][/p][p][b]Fast-paced and satisfying[/b] – perfect for breaks and casual moments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/b07a2dea1bd48f181bdcb7a70ceb671f60dcbade.gif"][/img][/p][p]Combining [b]battle royale-style shrinking safe zones[/b], [b]deep tower defense mechanics[/b], and [b]roguelike chaos[/b] in the style of [i]Vampire Survivors[/i].[/p][p]Fight to survive in the ruins of a doomed world. Every decision leads to a different survival path.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ [b]Unlock a Variety of Unique Mechs[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/4070ff32fe16bc31cd401e1a477146b219313a8e.png"][/img][/p][p]From swarm-clearing powerhouses to long-range artillery specialists — and even “Chad-only” paint jobs — every mech has its own style and combat role.[/p][p]The armory has everything ready for deployment. You focus on destruction — let the repair crew handle the rest.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 [b]Dual Perspective Combat – Two Modes, One Price[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/429c8faad343474b2c68353beab662a3fdbbc912.gif"][/img]Top-down shooter? Survivors-like? Not just that! Instantly switch to [b]third-person view[/b] for a full-on action shooter experience.[/p][p]Two perspectives, two gameplay feels — one explosive ride.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555670/d9c212a67fc63b5dba397369d16fcaff5cb1ad52.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🧭 [b]Are you ready, Survivor?[/b]
The fate of the world is in your hands.[/p][p]Join our official player group (QQ Group ID: 1006227144) and stand together against the apocalypse![/p]
